name: Old Man Gloom
label: Hydra Head
lede: Aaron Turner and Santos Montano started it in Santa Fe in 1999. Boston's Nate Newton and Caleb Scofield made it a four-man pile-up, and it has gone on for 25 years without saying when the joke ends.

eras.title: Fifteen tracks, under a week
eras.text: Old Man Gloom starts as a two-man project in New Mexico. Two Boston-area heavyweights arrive the next year, and the first record is made fast.

years.h: [[Aaron Turner|db3ca919-a4ab-451a-8f03-e51310cfd866]] and [[Santos Montano|20ef42c2-30e7-4ec3-8faa-af9d2074f9fc]] start a band in Santa Fe
years.p: Turner, then of [[Isis|5e521e8c-0ab2-44c4-8fd8-14d8d3321265]], and drummer Montano form Old Man Gloom in New Mexico in 1999.

years.h: Meditations in B is cut in under a week
years.p: Turner and Montano write and record the debut in New Mexico, 15 tracks in 29 minutes. It comes out on Tortuga Recordings, an imprint of Hydra Head Records.
years.xp:
Tim Stroh produced and Eric Gallegos engineered. Exclaim! described a record built from quick, jagged sonic barbs and long ambient experiments.

Hydra Head reissued a remastered version on April 7, 2015.

years.h: Nate Newton of Converge and Caleb Scofield of Cave In sign on
years.p: Newton takes guitar and Scofield bass, and a New Mexico duo becomes a Massachusetts supergroup.

eras.title: Two Seminars and a Christmas
eras.text: With Kurt Ballou at the board, the band puts out two albums on one day, then a holiday record that may or may not be a joke.

years.h: Two albums on one day, Seminar II and Seminar III
years.p: Seminar II runs 17 tracks and 58 minutes. Seminar III: Zozobra, out the same day, is a single 27-minute piece.
years.xp:
Kurt Ballou produced both. On Seminar II he engineered most of the tracks, and Luke Scarola recorded the rest and added electronics; Scarola stayed part of the sound through 2004. [[Stephen Brodsky|a0ff602c-7f3e-472d-8786-953da6cd7591]] of Cave In wrote the lyrics for "Mandied (Self: Reborn)".

Wikipedia dates Seminar II to March 20, 2001. AllMusic called it a roller coaster of ambient drones and metalcore attacks.

years.h: The 27-minute Seminar III names a future band
years.p: Sludge and doom in one long piece, produced by Ballou for Tortuga. Jay Randall of Agoraphobic Nosebleed adds electronics.
years.xp: The title was borrowed five years later by Scofield for his own band, [[Zozobra|a6b8ef30-1d47-4042-9b29-3963e4cd7a7a]].

years.cap: Aaron Turner with Isis in Colchester, UK, 2004
years.p: Turner, who runs Hydra Head, calls the fourth album one of the most engaging projects he has been part of. It runs 61 minutes.
years.xp: The final piece is built from alternate versions of the Christmas Eve segments. Reviews split: Drowned in Sound gave it 9/10 and Stylus a C+.

eras.title: Never broke up, never around
eras.text: Old Man Gloom never announces a hiatus and never makes a record either. Everyone's main bands are too busy.

years.h: Scofield starts Zozobra while Cave In is on hiatus
years.p: Caleb Scofield names his new band after the third Gloom album. Santos Montano plays in it briefly.

years.cap: Aaron Turner with Isis at Wagenhallen, Stuttgart
years.h: Isis ends, and Turner has his days back
years.p: Turner's main band dissolves in 2010. Isis had put out Panopticon, In the Absence of Truth and Wavering Radiant during Old Man Gloom's quiet years.
years.xp:
Meanwhile Newton's Converge released You Fail Me, No Heroes and Axe to Fall, and he started [[Doomriders|64ddf06c-850f-46ab-9552-10ef69647d8b]] in 2004.

Turner has said the band did things when they felt like it.

eras.title: Surprise: No
eras.text: After eight years the band returns with almost no warning, then pulls a trick on the press.

years.h: A Kurt Ballou tweet about a new record turns out to be a "joke"
years.p: The band records No at Ballou's God City Studio in 2011. A magazine ad Easter egg and Ballou's tweet, which he later called a late April Fools' joke, hint at it first.

years.big: "It felt to me like it fell together very naturally."
years.h: Facebook announces No, and the tour starts the next day
years.p: Aaron Turner on the reunion, in 2012. The band posts the news on May 1; shows begin May 2, with copies of the album for sale on the road.
years.xp:
Turner told The Quietus in September 2012 that the eight-year gap was never meant to be one: "it wasn't a break up, it was just a sort of informal hiatus." He said everyone had been absorbed by other projects and personal lives.

Playing again, he said, "didn't feel like a train that was about to derail."

years.cap: Old Man Gloom at Bar Le Ritz PDB, Montreal
years.p: Ballou produces the fifth album, released as HH666-235. Nine tracks, 56 minutes.
years.xp: Kevin Baker of The Hope Conspiracy, Ballou, and Mike McKenzie of The Red Chord are credited as guests. Pitchfork gave it 7.2.

yt: Here Is A Gift for You, the documentary
years.h: Two albums called The Ape of God, and one fake for critics
years.p: Both come out November 11 on Profound Lore Records. Critics had been sent an edited eight-track blend of the two.
years.xp:
The band recorded with Kurt Ballou in December 2013 and June 2014. The promo mixed shorter, edited songs from both albums; "The Lash" ran under three minutes there and about seven on the real release. Clash gave the promo 9/10.

Decibel's Adrien Begrand wrote: "I didn't appreciate being jerked around and having my precious time wasted by a bunch of smug musicians." Newton: "People either love [the joke] or they're fucking angry."

Vinyl came out on SIGE. Rolling Stone ranked both albums fourth on its 2014 metal list.

years.h: Hydra Head reissues a remastered Meditations in B
years.p: The debut gets its remaster 15 years after the first Tortuga pressing.

eras.title: Caleb
eras.text: The band loses its bassist, decides to go on, and brings in a member of Cave In to replace him.

years.big: "Yesterday the world lost a very special person: Caleb Scofield."
years.h: Caleb Scofield dies at 39 in New Hampshire
years.p: The Old Man Gloom, Cave In and Zozobra bassist died March 28, 2018, when his truck hit a toll booth in Bedford. The band's statement ran the next day.
years.xp:
Wikipedia gives the cause of death as smoke and heat inhalation, thermal injuries and multiple blunt impact injuries. A crowdfunding campaign for his family raised roughly $72,000.

Turner asked Montano whether he still wanted to do Old Man Gloom. Montano said: "we have to now. We don't have a choice."

years.cap: Nate Newton with Converge at Roadburn, April 19, 2018
years.h: Boston plays a benefit for Scofield's family
years.p: On June 13, 2018, Converge and Young Widows play, with Scofield's brother Kyle, Nate Newton and Stephen Brodsky covering bass.
years.xp: A Los Angeles benefit followed October 13, 2018 with Pelican, 27 and Celestial, an Isis reunion under another name.

years.cap: Old Man Gloom at Roadburn, with Brodsky on bass
years.h: Stephen Brodsky of Cave In takes over on bass
years.p: Brodsky, who played the Boston tribute, is confirmed as a member in December 2018 and starts on a new record.

years.h: Seminar IX appears online first, with Brodsky on bass
years.p: The surprise release on Profound Lore is the first of two 2020 records.
The companion album folds in his posthumous parts. Louder Sound singled out "Final Defeat", with its Cave In flavor.

sources.title: Rolling Stone: Caleb Scofield dead at 39
